assertions.assertion: The patient presents with a history of paroxysmal palpitations and episodic lightheadedness, raising concern for recurrent supraventricular tachycardia and underlying atrial fibrillation.
Given the recent transient cerebral ischemic attack, continuous ambulatory Holter monitoring study is indicated to assess arrhythmic burden and guide anticoagulation therapy.
The continuous ambulatory Holter monitoring study is coded as CPT 93226.
The diagnoses are I48.91 and G45.9.
